title: Maps between strict quotient presentations
statement: Let Q,R be integral cochain complexes on W and C,D cochain complexes of strict coefficient systems. Give finite chain isomorphisms kappaC_n:evaluation_n(C)≅scalarExtension_n(Q) and kappaD_n:evaluation_n(D)≅scalarExtension_n(R), commuting with the actual horizontal quotient transitions. For every integral chain map h:Q→R there exists a strict chain map f:C→D whose finite component satisfies evaluation_n(f_i) followed by (kappaD_n)_i = (kappaC_n)_i followed by scalarExtension_n(h_i), for every n and i.

source.place: Scalar-extension adjunction and ordinary open extension (Tags 03CZ and 03DJ), with sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY and 0941; ordinary and augmentation steps of lem-sf-open-restriction-counit-on-good-complexes.

proof.text: Conjugate scalar extension of h by the finite presentation isomorphisms in each degree. Their horizontal equations and quotient-transformation naturality show these maps commute with horizontal restrictions.

Use the public continuity instance for the vertical inclusion. Over an arbitrary ringed sequence site, undo the identity scalar restriction in finite evaluation to obtain actual linear component maps. The section formula for the quotient transitions converts horizontal compatibility to naturality; vertical naturality and the factorization of a product-site arrow construct a module-sheaf morphism. Specialize this proved construction to the coefficient ring, without unfolding its sheafification.

Ordinary evaluations are jointly faithful. Evaluate the differential equations to obtain those of the finite conjugate chain maps; this assembles a strict chain map with the required finite components.

lean.statement:
theorem strictReductionPresentationMap
    (Q R : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (C D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
    (κC : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
    (κD : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D ≅
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj R)
    (hC : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (coefficientSequenceTransition l E W h)
        (.up ℤ)).app C ≫
        ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E W h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (κC n).hom =
      (κC m).hom ≫
        (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (coefficientOrdinaryQuotient l E W h)
          (.up ℤ)).app Q)
    (hD : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (coefficientSequenceTransition l E W h)
        (.up ℤ)).app D ≫
        ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E W h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (κD n).hom =
      (κD m).hom ≫
        (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (coefficientOrdinaryQuotient l E W h)
          (.up ℤ)).app R)
    (h : Q ⟶ R) :
    ∃ f : C ⟶ D, ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).map (f.f i) ≫ (κD n).hom.f i =
        (κC n).hom.f i ≫ (scalarReductionExtension l E W n).map (h.f i)
